cost.basis: assumed percent of notional per round trip in a stock future; statutory about 0.03, brokerage about 0.02, slippage and spread about 0.10; not a tax computation

assumptions.benchmark: equal-weight F&O universe (primary); same-industry equal-weight excluding the stock, >=3 peers (second)
assumptions.holidays: weekdays used for days to expiry; exchange holidays ignored

limitations: One year of data (260 sessions); U has 59 sessions. All three windows are one regime sequence.
Cash returns proxy a futures trade; the 0.15% round-trip cost is assumed.
Far-month contracts are thin; far_only is expected to be noisy. Weekdays to expiry ignore exchange holidays.
Clustering by underlying and cross-sectional dependence beyond the session mean are not modelled.
A missing adjusted price (for example the 2026-02-01 session) removes the outcome; it is never filled.
Nothing here is validated; a 'supported' verdict still needs live shadow validation.

roll_and_timing.definition: near_only, pooled U+V+T, primary horizon, net benchmark-relative; descriptive only, never used to select a setting

agreement_and_migration.migration_groups: OI change flat = within +-1%; groups may overlap
